adaptive_overhead_acceptance.adaptive_vs_valid_fixed_requirement: adaptive mean physical probe count <= best coverage-valid fixed Top-K
adaptive_overhead_acceptance.fixed_comparator_rule: first determine which fixed Top-K baselines independently pass the same nominal coverage criterion across all four horizons; among coverage-valid fixed baselines use the smallest K as the fair overhead comparator
adaptive_overhead_acceptance.hard_exhaustive_requirement: adaptive mean physical probe count < exhaustive beam count for each codebook
adaptive_overhead_acceptance.if_no_fixed_topk_is_coverage_valid: report that fact explicitly; fixed comparison is descriptive and the hard overhead requirement remains adaptive < exhaustive
adaptive_overhead_acceptance.why_top1_is_not_unconditional_target: a lower-overhead fixed policy that fails the requested reliability target is not a valid reliability-overhead comparator

evaluation_granularity.primary_completion_rule: all evaluable nominal-q codebook/horizon strata must pass; n=0 is NOT_EVALUABLE and cannot silently pass
evaluation_granularity.primary_tests: separate test for every codebook_size x horizon
evaluation_granularity.reason: avoid treating correlated horizons from one selected receiver/scene as independent Bernoulli observations

formal_empirical_coverage_tolerance.important_limitation: PASS is finite-sample consistency with requested_q; it is not proof that the unknown population coverage is >= q
formal_empirical_coverage_tolerance.interpretation: no statistically significant evidence that empirical containment is below the requested posterior-mass target

receiver_denominator_contract.invalid_future_endpoint: exclude only from that horizon's Bernoulli denominator and report the unavailable endpoint count
receiver_denominator_contract.no_eligible_receiver: count explicitly in receiver availability; do not substitute another actor
receiver_denominator_contract.selected_receiver_prediction_unavailable: count explicitly; do not substitute the second-best receiver
